# Liberica NIK versions: numeric components, then the build; a version without a build equals any build of it

23.1.8 = 23.1.8+1
23.1.3 < 23.1.8

23.1.12+1 < 23.1.12.1+1
23.0.0+1 < 23.1.0+1
